mapper.select: SELECT I.ID, I.KINDERGARTEN_ID, I.USER_ID, U.NAME USER_NAME, U.ACCOUNT_TYPE, I.INVITER_ID, V.NAME INVITER_NAME, I.TYPE, I.ROLE_ID, I.DIRECTION, I.STATUS, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(I.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(I.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT FROM T_INVITE I JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = I.USER_ID LEFT JOIN T_USER V ON V.ID = I.INVITER_ID WHERE I.KINDERGARTEN_ID = #{kindergartenId} AND I.STATUS = 'PENDING'

SELECT I.ID, I.KINDERGARTEN_ID, K.NAME KINDERGARTEN_NAME, I.USER_ID, U.NAME USER_NAME, U.ACCOUNT_TYPE, I.INVITER_ID, V.NAME INVITER_NAME, I.TYPE, I.ROLE_ID, I.DIRECTION, I.STATUS, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(I.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(I.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT FROM T_INVITE I JOIN T_KINDERGARTEN K ON K.ID = I.KINDERGARTEN_ID JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = I.USER_ID LEFT JOIN T_USER V ON V.ID = I.INVITER_ID
WHERE (I.USER_ID = #{userId} OR (I.DIRECTION = 'JOIN' AND I.INVITER_ID = #{userId})) AND I.STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_INVITE(KINDERGARTEN_ID, USER_ID, INVITER_ID, TYPE, ROLE_ID, DIRECTION, STATUS) VALUES (#{kindergartenId}, #{userId}, #{inviterId}, #{type}, #{roleId}, #{direction}, 'PENDING')
